original_value: Fictional compact audio interface bundle for home recording and podcast production. Includes a desktop USB-C interface, condenser microphone, and isolation monitor pack. Designed for creators who want low-latency monitoring, dual combo inputs, and simple plug-and-play operation on laptops and tablets.
